title: Print Queue Triage
brief: A shared print server holds pending jobs as a chain of ListNode entries, each carrying a size score. At peak time the server lets small jobs jump ahead: every job with a score below a threshold should be moved ahead of every job whose score is not.

Implement triageQueue(head, x), where head is the first job in the queue and x is the threshold, and return the head of the rearranged queue in which all jobs scoring less than x come before all the other jobs.
